description: Cookbook: at session start, says when a daily update report is waiting (reads ~/.local/share/stack-updates only); at session start, on a prompt and after a tool, says which model the usage budget asks for (reads the Claude usage at a session start, at most once per ten minutes, and the reading T3 Code saves when that read is refused; writes ~/.local/share/model-budget only); before a T3 tool starts an agent that is not Claude, runs the Codex start check and denies a start it refuses or cannot check (recipes/codex.md); around a question dialog, notes that one was shown and whether it was answered (the chat, the repository and the time, never a question or an answer; writes ~/.local/share/claude-cookbook/owner-answers only), and before one, stops it once to name the other chats of the repository that put questions to the owner; before a T3 tool starts a new chat, stops it once to look at the chats that exist, and before a chat first changes a file of a repository, stops it once to look at those chats and at the files the open pull requests change (recipes/parallel-chats.md); before a Bash or PowerShell call, denies a local test run or Semgrep scan in a repository on boat-run's upload list and names the boat-run command to use instead, unless the command ends with a `# local-run: <why>` comment (reads git and ~/.local/share/boat-run/upload-allowed.txt only; recipes/boat.md); at a turn's end, stops once a closing message that leaves an owner question unasked or a finished T3 chat unsettled (recipes/owner-questions.md).
